status: ruled by Nate in chat on 2026-10-17. These are the only home of R3 and R4 until the D16 amendment (W-92) folds them into ontology-decisions.md; W-92 then deletes this file. A ruling applies at analysis time and never edits a run log.

rulings.question: Is a house or backup-power battery Energy or Device Health?
rulings.ruling: Device Health. A house or backup-unit battery is handled like any device battery: its charge and condition are about that device, and the action is to charge or replace it.

rulings.question: Where do life-safety alarm flags (CO, smoke, leak) surface while staying alarm flags that never feed a comfort or air badge?
rulings.ruling: Option B, stay with the measurement: the CO reading lives in Air Quality and the leak state in Security & Presence (as D16 already places leaks). The alarm state itself surfaces only through alerts and never feeds a topic badge. A dedicated Safety home (option A, the existing SAFETY device category) was considered and not chosen.
